p1_findings.finding: The +13.54% diagnostic delta is a same-constraint whole-design observation, not an ablation. Sequential cells rise by 999 and combinational cells by 5,516, but the reports alone do not isolate what fraction comes from the second response slot, coherence/control logic, or design-rule buffering.
p1_findings.impact: The delta is useful for choosing a DSE direction, but cannot yet support a paper statement that the two slots themselves cost the full delta.
p1_findings.required_action: Use the bounded one-slot and registered-SRAM-output variants as explicit ablations; retain only final all-constraint-clean results.

closed_during_review.closure: The sealed failure receipt was corrected and re-sealed before this final review: -0.2161 is classified as max transition, max capacitance 2/-0.0363 is present, hold is +0.0101 ns, and the exact area ratio/percentage now recompute to 1.135446598357162/+13.5446598357162%.

receipt_blind_report_parse.taxonomy_note: The -0.2161 value is max-transition slack, not hold timing slack. Hold timing is MET at +0.0101 ns.

runner_audit.runner_rule: Require all five max-delay/min-delay/max-capacitance/max-transition/max-fanout groups to report no violations.

variant_1_recommended_first.name: ONE_FULL_WIDTH_SLOT_PLUS_NARROW_SKID_OR_REPLAY
variant_1_recommended_first.mechanism: Retain one 1152-bit parent response slot. Use explicit backpressure plus at most a narrow valid/ID/source skid token when macro response and RAW forward would otherwise dual-enqueue; replay or defer the younger source rather than adding a second full-width standard-cell data slot.
mandatory_functional_gate: Freeze a new exact RTL SHA and contract.
Run the complete M478 base suite through the variant; all nine base covers must remain nonzero and all lane/ID postconditions must pass.
Run the sealed old=5/new=1 stalled same-address attack and both nonvacuous hazard covers.
Add a repeated response-plus-forward collision test proving no loss, duplication, stale data, reorder, or reservation overflow.

variant_2_only_if_real_macro_model_exist.name: REGISTERED_SRAM_OUTPUT_AS_FIRST_RESPONSE_HOLDING_STAGE
variant_2_only_if_real_macro_model_exist.mechanism: Use a characterized synchronous SRAM's registered/holdable output as the first response stage and retain only necessary valid/ID control or one bounded skid. The macro output register cannot be treated as free or excluded unless its .db, behavioral timing contract and area/power are included.
mandatory_macro_gate: Freeze exact SRAM macro .db and simulation model identities.
Prove output retention under consumer stall and response-plus-forward collision.
Include macro area, timing and power; do not compare a macro-inclusive variant against logic-only M477 as paper PPA.

common_synthesis_and_decision_gate: After independent VCS hammer, rerun the exact same 3.000 ns SDC, slow/fast libraries and hold-fix flow.
All five constraint groups must be clean: setup, hold timing, max capacitance, max transition and max fanout. Any violation is immediate NO-GO.
Use M477 only as a diagnostic DSE reference. Retain a variant only if final clean cell area is at least 5% below 42,370.649130 um2.
Measure extra stalls on the same frozen transaction trace; require no more than 2% cycle regression versus sealed dual-slot behavior before further admission.
If neither of the two variants passes both gates, stop this queue DSE; do not open a third structural variant in this sprint.
